title: Nebius Group (NBIS) Is Up 14.6% After Nvidia-Funded AI Pivot and Major Cloud Deals - What's Changed
title_zh: Nvidia 资助的 AI Pivot 和重大云交易后 Nebius Group (NBIS) 上涨 14.6% - 发生了什么变化
summary: Nebius Group recently deepened its AI push by acquiring Eigen AI for about US$643 million, securing very large multiyear AI compute contracts with Meta and Microsoft, and receiving a US$2 billion investment from Nvidia to expand its neocloud data center capacity.
summary_zh: Nebius Group 最近以约 6.43 亿美元收购 Eigen AI，与 Meta 和微软签订了非常大的多年期人工智能计算合同，并获得 Nvidia 的 20 亿美元投资以扩大其 neocloud 数据中心容量，从而深化了其人工智能发展。

title: Nebius Group Recasts AI Future With Eigen AI Deal And Mega Partnerships
title_zh: Nebius Group 通过 Eigen AI 交易和大型合作伙伴关系重塑 AI 未来
summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) announced a $643 million acquisition of Eigen AI, adding advanced inference and optimization technology to its AI platform.
summary_zh: Nebius Group（纳斯达克股票代码：NBIS）宣布以 6.43 亿美元收购 Eigen AI，为其人工智能平台增添先进的推理和优化技术。

title: Microsoft Deal Strengthens Black Hills Corporation (BKH) Prospects as a High Growth Utility Stock to Buy

summary: Black Hills Corporation (NYSE:BKH) is one of the high growth utility stocks to buy according to analysts. On April 15, analysts at BMO Capital reiterated an Outperform rating on Black Hills Corporation (NYSE:BKH) and raised the price target to $91 from $84.

title: Apple Intel Chip Deal Reshapes Supply Chain And Valuation Debate
title_zh: 苹果英特尔芯片交易重塑供应链和估值争论
summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has reached a preliminary agreement for Intel to manufacture chips for its devices. The deal signals a move away from sole reliance on TSMC for advanced chip production. The arrangement involves active participation from the U.S.

title: Apollo, Blackstone reportedly in talks for $35B Broadcom financing deal
title_zh: 据报道，Apollo 和 Blackstone 正在就 35B 美元 Broadcom 融资交易进行谈判
summary: Investing.com -- Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc. are in discussions with Broadcom Inc. regarding approximately $35 billion in financing to support the chipmaker’s artificial intelligence chip development, according to a Bloomberg report Friday.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据彭博社周五报道，阿波罗全球管理公司和黑石公司正在与博通公司讨论约 350 亿美元的融资，以支持该芯片制造商的人工智能芯片开发。
